name: Chinese figures at a foodstall, and three other sketches, Macau
summary: (LL) A man stooping over a basket of vegetables; (LR) two figures at a foodstall; (to its right) study of a cooking pot; (UR) two Macanese women with a servant, who holds a parasol above them; (UC) three figures in a Tanka boat, the two women holding up poles and the man stepping ashore from the bow

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
